question: Reacting Gas Volumes - Water Formation

question: Reacting Gas Volumes - Ammonia Synthesis
stem: In the reaction: N2(g) + 3H2(g) → 2NH3(g), 10 cm³ of nitrogen gas reacts completely with 30 cm³ of hydrogen gas. What volume of ammonia gas is produced at r.t.p.?

question: Limiting Reactant from Moles
stem: Sodium reacts with chlorine according to the equation: 2Na + Cl2 → 2NaCl. If 0.60 mol of Na is mixed with 0.40 mol of Cl2, which is the limiting reactant and how much NaCl is produced?
options: Na is limiting; 0.60 mol of NaCl formed
Cl2 is limiting; 0.80 mol of NaCl formed
Na is limiting; 0.30 mol of NaCl formed
Cl2 is limiting; 0.40 mol of NaCl formed
answer: Na is limiting; 0.60 mol of NaCl formed

question: Molar Mass from Gas Density
